sources.title: Fee Structure for the AY 2026-27 for JEE (Advanced) Students (4 Yr. B.Tech/Integrated M.Tech/Dual Degree/Preparatory)
sources.publisher: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad - Office of Dean Student's Welfare

scholarships.name: Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW)
scholarships.eligibility: Open to JEE-Advanced-admitted B.Tech, Dual Degree, Integrated M.Tech and Integrated BS-MS students whose gross annual family income (parents plus student, all sources, before deductions) is Rs 5 lakh or less; not applicable to SC/ST/PwD students, who are already exempt from tuition.
scholarships.benefit: Full tuition waiver when family income is under Rs 1 lakh a year; a two-thirds tuition waiver for the Rs 1-5 lakh band; no waiver above Rs 5 lakh.

sources.title: Notice: Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) and Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for AY 2026-27
sources.publisher: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad - Office of Dean Student's Welfare

scholarships.name: Merit-cum-Means (MCM) Scholarship including Free-ship
scholarships.eligibility: Open to B.Tech, Dual Degree, Integrated M.Tech/BS-MS (up to 4th year), M.Sc Tech, M.Sc, M.A. and MBA students with gross annual family income up to Rs 6 lakh; first-years ranked by JEE-Advanced CRL, later years need CGPA 6.0+ and no pending backlog; not for SC/ST/PwD, who are already fee-exempt.
scholarships.benefit: 35% of each year's enrolled students are covered on merit: the top 25% get a full tuition refund plus a Rs 1,000/month stipend for 10 months, and the next 10% get only the tuition refund.

sources.title: Notice: Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) and Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for AY 2026-27
sources.publisher: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad - Office of Dean Student's Welfare

scholarships.name: Top-Rank Full Tuition Waiver
scholarships.eligibility: The top 10 candidates admitted to IIT (ISM) Dhanbad with a JEE (Advanced) 2026 Common Rank List (CRL) rank up to 1000, conditional on maintaining good academic and disciplinary standing.
scholarships.benefit: Full waiver of the tuition fee for the entire duration of the undergraduate programme.
